verdict.rationale: BILL documents a few specific event-triggered rules. Custom approval policies are "a set of rules" that decide which bills need approval, by whom, and when. Vendor autopay automatically pays a vendor when a bill is created, and tolerance rules govern PO matching. Webhooks deliver real-time event notifications but only inform external systems; they are a developer building block, not an in-product rule engine. missing for 10: a general user-definable trigger→action rule builder, Spend & Expense-specific automation rules (card/transaction events triggering actions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
